--[=[
--Add Breach Adrenaline and Ordnance Velocity

Cruising Speed.Description: Increase Speed by 80% when no enemies within 3000m

Void Hole.Description: Creates a 150m black hole that sucks in enemies, dealing 300 Damage per second over 12s.

Form Up.Description: Recall all Crew Members to the Railjack and Heal them for 100%

Particle Ram.Description: Deploy a Particle Ram dealing 1500 Damage per second when moving forward, 2250 during a Vector Maneuver. Deactivate to launch the Ram outwards for 4s, dealing 3000 Damage.

Winged Steel.Description: Increase nearby ally Archwing Armor by 360% within 1000m

Predator.Description: Increase all Turret Critical Chance by +80%

Last Stand.Description: Increase All Turret Damage by 128% when Hull is below 20%

Void Cloak.Description:
Cloak from Enemies for 50s
Engine Speed reduced to 50%

Squad Renew.Description: Heal all Railjack squad members by 100%.

Munitions Vortex.Description: Deploy a bubble that absorbs fire for 15s. Detonates for all accumulated damage over 150m.

Shatter Burst.Description: Creates a barrage of 7 explosions per second over 20 seconds, dealing 1000 Damage in 80m.

Artillery Cheap Shot.Description: Forward Artillery has a +50% chance to not consume Dome Charges

Tether.Description: Emits a field that restricts the movement of 8 enemy targets within 120m for 15s. Enemies are 50% more vulnerable to Railjack weapons, and those destroyed while tethered Detonate for 2000 Damage over 80m.

Ordnance Cheap Shot.Description: Ordnance weapons have a +50% chance to not consume Munitions

Countermeasures.Description: Deploy 32 flares that will distract enemy guided projectiles.
Countermeasures.Flux:
5.
Each subsequent use within 4 seconds doubles the cost (Max 40).

Sentient Scalpel.Description: Increase Gunnery Damage vs Sentients by +25.3%

Section Density.Description: Increase all Turret Critical Damage by +78.4%

Sentient Fortitude.Description: Decrease Shield Damage from Sentients by +25.3%

Flow Burn.Description: Increase Speed and Boost Speed by 38% for 13s

Turret Velocity.Description:
Increase Turret Range by +25.3%
Increase Turret Projectile Speed by +55%

Fiery Phoenix.Description: Leave a trail of fire dealing 300 Damage per second to enemies. Gain 20% Speed and 30% Damage Reduction while active. Accumulates 100 Damage per second that unleashes upon deactivation over 275m.
Fiery Phoenix.Flux: 50 on use. 2.5 per second while active

Intruder Stasis.Description: Freeze al Enemy Boarding Parties for 45s

Breach Adrenaline.Description: Increase Shield Regen during Breach by +38%

Winged Storm.Description: Increase nearby ally Archwing Damage by 20% within 1000m

Blackout Pulse.Description: Deploy an Electro-Magnetic Pulse dealing 500 Damage to enemies within 200m and disabling them temporarily. Manually detonate to increase the Blast Radius to 300m.
